description:
Implement indefinite (TTL=0) lease semantics with mandatory reason, heartbeats, staleness detection, and policy enforcement.

## Scope
Add TTL=0 lease support to the claim coordination system with operational guardrails to prevent deadlocks while enabling manual oversight scenarios.

## Requirements

### Lease Acquisition
- Accept `ttl_secs = 0` in `claim acquire` operation
- Require non-empty `--reason` flag for TTL=0 leases
- Enforce per-agent limit: `max_indefinite_leases_per_agent` (default: 2)
- Enforce per-repository limit: `max_indefinite_leases_per_repo` (default: 10)
- Check repository policy allows indefinite leases for requested scope

### Heartbeat and Staleness
- For TTL=0 leases: set `expires_at = null` in index
- Track `last_beat` timestamp (updated on renew/heartbeat operations)
- Mark lease as `stale: true` if `now - last_beat > stale_threshold_secs`
- Add `heartbeat` operation to claims JSONL (updates `last_beat`, no expiry change)

### Index Schema Updates
- Add `stale_threshold_secs` to index root (from config)
- Add `ttl_secs` field to lease entries
- Add `last_beat` field to lease entries
- Add `stale` boolean field to lease entries (derived during index rebuild)

### Hook Enforcement
- Pre-commit: reject structural edits when lease has `stale: true`
- Pre-push: reject commits with stale lease trailers

### CLI Updates
- `jit claim acquire <issue> --ttl 0 --reason "..."` validates policy and limits
- `jit claim renew <lease-id>` updates `last_beat` for TTL=0 leases
- `jit claim status` highlights indefinite leases with time since last beat

### Configuration Schema
- Add `coordination.stale_threshold_secs = 3600`
- Add `coordination.max_indefinite_leases_per_agent = 2`
- Add `coordination.max_indefinite_leases_per_repo = 10`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] TTL=0 leases can be acquired with mandatory `--reason`
- [ ] Per-agent and per-repo limits enforced
- [ ] Staleness detection marks inactive TTL=0 leases as stale
- [ ] Heartbeat operation updates `last_beat` without changing expiry
- [ ] Pre-commit/pre-push hooks reject stale leases
- [ ] Claims index rebuild correctly computes staleness
- [ ] Config schema includes staleness threshold and limits
- [ ] Property-based tests validate staleness transitions

## Design Reference
See `dev/design/worktree-parallel-work.md` sections:
- "Indefinite (TTL=0) Leases"
- "Automatic Expiration and Staleness"
- "Lease Operations" (heartbeat logic)
- Claims JSONL and Index schemas
title: Implement TTL=0 indefinite lease support with staleness detection
